# Claims Assessment Memo

**Insured:** Alder Mews Architects
**Policy:** CC-1518

## 1. Summary

Alder Mews Architects reported the accidental drop of a tablet and a drawing display during transport at a hotel meeting room in Leeds, with no third party involved. The claim is assessed as covered under clause 4.5 (Transit) of the policy. No exclusion applies on the file. The reserve is 3,642 dollars with no excess deducted. Two points should be confirmed with the insured (see section 3).

## 2. Facts

- The insured reported the loss on 25 June 2026 under policy CC-1518. [notice of loss]
- The loss was described as an accidental drop during transport of a tablet and a drawing display, at a hotel meeting room in Leeds. [notice of loss]
- An incident report, reference IR/2026/4182, is dated 27 June 2026 and was made by Alder Mews Architects. [incident report]
- The incident report lists the items as a tablet and a drawing display. It gives the circumstances as an accidental drop during transport at a hotel meeting room in Leeds, with no third party involved. [incident report]
- The tablet is supported by an invoice from Beacon Office Supply for 2,018 dollars. [invoice 1]
- The drawing display is supported by an invoice from Crane & Sons Electronics for 1,624 dollars. [invoice 2]
- The file contains no allegation of theft and no police report. [notice of loss], [incident report]
- The file does not state who was carrying the items, or which premises they were being carried between. [notice of loss], [incident report]
- The policy extract does not include a schedule, so no excess is shown. [policy]

## 3. Coverage analysis

**Insuring clause.** Clause 4.5 covers "accidental loss of or damage to portable equipment while being carried by an employee between premises." [policy, clause 4.5] The loss is an accidental drop of a tablet and a drawing display during transport. [notice of loss], [incident report] Both are portable items and the cause is accidental, which fits clause 4.5.

**Points to confirm.** Clause 4.5 requires that the items were carried by an employee between premises. The file records "transport" but does not name the carrier or the premises. [incident report] These two points should be confirmed with the insured. The nature and extent of the damage is also not described in the file, and this should be obtained for the repair or replacement stage.

**Other insuring clauses.**
- Clause 4.2 responds only to theft, fire, storm or escape of water. A drop is none of these, so it is not the basis for cover. [policy, clause 4.2]
- Clause 4.7 (escape of water) and clause 4.9 (electrical surge) are not engaged. The file records no water or electrical event. [policy, clauses 4.7, 4.9], [incident report]

**Exclusions.**
- **Clause 7.1 (Unattended property)** applies to theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space. [policy, clause 7.1] No theft is reported and the loss is a drop during transport, so it does not apply. [notice of loss], [incident report]
- **Clause 7.3 (Wear and tear)** excludes gradual deterioration. [policy, clause 7.3] The reported cause is a single accidental drop, not gradual deterioration, so it does not apply. [incident report]
- **Clause 7.5 (Unproven loss)** excludes a loss not reported to the police within seven days where theft is alleged. [policy, clause 7.5] Theft is not alleged, so no police report is required and it does not apply. [notice of loss], [incident report]

## 4. Decision

**Covered**, under clause 4.5 (Transit) [policy, clause 4.5], subject to confirmation that the items were being carried by an employee between premises. No exclusion in clauses 7.1, 7.3 or 7.5 applies.

## 5. Reserve

Under clause 9.1, the reserve is the sum of the invoices in the file, less the 250 dollar excess where the policy schedule applies one. Where no excess is shown in the schedule, none applies. [policy, clause 9.1] No schedule is in the file and no excess is shown, so none is deducted.

| Item | Amount (dollars) |
|---|---|
| Tablet [invoice 1] | 2,018 |
| Drawing display [invoice 2] | 1,624 |
| Excess | 0 |
| **Reserve** | **3,642** |
